root_cause.text: The cls_u32 classifier in net/sched/cls_u32.c passes potentially negative offset values (computed from user-controlled fields in the filter rule) to `skb_header_pointer()`, which does not properly validate negative offsets, causing an out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "skb_header_pointer() does not fully validate negative @offset values" and the patch replaces all calls to `skb_header_pointer()` with `skb_header_pointer_careful()` in `u32_classify()`. The KASAN report shows a slab-out-of-bounds at line 221 of cls_u32.c, and the patch removes a previous check (`if (skb_headroom(skb) + toff > INT_MAX)`) that was insufficient to catch all negative offsets.
